dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are defined by high-intensity light-colored perimeters approximately 3-8 pixels wide. These perimeters exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the dark exterior background to the light-colored ring, surrounding a localized low-intensity interior core. Five prominent structures are distributed across the dorsal mid-line and upper-right quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, non-gradient light-colored pixel clusters is concentrated along the lateral-ventral boundaries. These solid high-intensity blobs are clustered more densely on the left and right peripheral edges than in the central dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the central 'O' annulus, the secondary annulus located 45 degrees to the bottom-left, and the high-intensity cluster on the right-lateral edge form a scalene triangle with the obtuse angle oriented toward the dorsal peak.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, reticulated web-like network of fine high-intensity lines interconnects the larger macro-annuli and blobs, creating a lace-like texture across the lower posterior region.
